name: Kind words cheer a sad Boop up at once
case: No agent is working. The person tells Boop they had a bad day, and it turns sad with them. Half a minute later they ask why it's so sad: that's no reason to cheer up, so it stays sad. Then they tell it to be happy, that it's the best: Boop's mood lifts at once, to happy, with a face that isn't sad.
